subtopics.label: Racial & Ethnic Disparities in Maternal Morbidity and Mortality
subtopics.description: Research examining racial and ethnic inequities in severe maternal morbidity, mortality, obstetric readmissions, and delivery outcomes across U.S. hospital systems and states. Includes studies on hospital-level racial composition, anesthesia disparities, and interventions to reduce perinatal health inequities.
subtopics.short_description: Racial and ethnic disparities in severe maternal morbidity, mortality, and delivery outcomes across U.S. hospital systems.

subtopics.label: Perinatal Mental Health: Anxiety, Depression, and Psychosocial Risk
subtopics.description: Studies on the prevalence, prediction, biological mechanisms, and clinical management of perinatal mental health conditions including postpartum depression, antenatal anxiety, and peripartum mood disorders. Covers machine learning prediction models, neuroactive steroids, immune phenotypes, and psychosocial risk factors.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, prediction, and management of postpartum depression, antenatal anxiety, and peripartum mood disorders.

subtopics.label: Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy and Cardiovascular Outcomes
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical research on hypertensive disorders of pregnancy including preeclampsia, chronic hypertension, and their associations with maternal cardiovascular morbidity, cerebral oxygen metabolism, postpartum hypertension persistence, and long-term cardiovascular risk.
subtopics.short_description: Preeclampsia, chronic hypertension, and long-term cardiovascular outcomes associated with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 in Pregnancy: Outcomes, Vaccination, and Perinatal Impact
subtopics.description: Population-level and clinical research on SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination during pregnancy, including effects on birth outcomes, placental pathology, maternal morbidity, postpartum length of stay, neonatal management, and vaccine safety and effectiveness in pregnant populations.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level impacts of SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccine safety on birth outcomes, placental pathology, and neonatal health.

subtopics.label: Prenatal Substance Use, Policy, and Child Welfare Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology and policy landscape of substance use during pregnancy, including opioid use disorder, cannabis use, prenatal drug screening, and the effects of punitive versus supportive state laws on maternal health, infant maltreatment reports, neonatal outcomes, and child welfare involvement.
subtopics.display_name: Prenatal Substance Use & Child Welfare Policy
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology and policy effects of opioid and cannabis use in pregnancy on infant outcomes and child welfare involvement.

subtopics.label: Gestational Diabetes: Screening, Prevalence, and Community Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on gestational diabetes mellitus prevalence across diverse populations, glucose challenge test performance and associated outcomes, community health worker-led screening programs, and online support interventions for GDM management.
subtopics.short_description: GDM prevalence across diverse populations, glucose screening performance, and community health worker-led management programs.

subtopics.label: Viral Hepatitis (B and C) in Pregnancy and Perinatal Transmission
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical research on hepatitis B and C infection during pregnancy, including seroprevalence, adherence to care guidelines, adverse pregnancy outcomes, mother-to-child transmission risk, and treatment approaches during the perinatal period.
subtopics.short_description: Hepatitis B and C seroprevalence, adverse pregnancy outcomes, and mother-to-child transmission risk during the perinatal period.

subtopics.label: Intrapartum Care, Labor Management, and Cesarean Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on intrapartum clinical practices including oxytocin regimens, cervical ripening, labor analgesia, cesarean delivery decision-making, enhanced recovery after cesarean, VBAC outcomes, and perinatal complications associated with obstetric interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Intrapartum clinical practices including oxytocin regimens, cervical ripening, labor analgesia, and cesarean decision-making.

subtopics.label: Penicillin Allergy Management in Obstetric Patients
subtopics.description: Studies examining the prevalence, clinical management, and outcomes of reported penicillin allergy in pregnant women, including GBS prophylaxis alternatives, outpatient allergy evaluation programs, neonatal outcomes, and cost analyses of antepartum referral programs.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and clinical management of reported penicillin allergy in pregnancy, including GBS prophylaxis and neonatal outcomes.

subtopics.label: Placenta Accreta Spectrum: Imaging, Risk Factors, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the diagnosis, ultrasound detection, risk stratification, and clinical outcomes of placenta accreta spectrum disorders, including the role of prior cesarean and myomectomy, novel imaging signs, and prevention through reducing unnecessary cesarean deliveries.
subtopics.short_description: Ultrasound detection, risk stratification, and clinical outcomes of placenta accreta spectrum disorders.

subtopics.label: Family Planning, Contraceptive Access, and Reproductive Health in Tanzania
subtopics.description: Community-based and qualitative research on contraceptive uptake, autonomy, and family planning education in rural Tanzania, including the role of religious leaders, health provider perspectives, and external social influences on women's contraceptive decision-making.
subtopics.display_name: Contraceptive Access & Family Planning in Tanzania
subtopics.short_description: Community-based research on contraceptive uptake, autonomy, and reproductive health education in rural Tanzania.

subtopics.label: Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health Education and Access
subtopics.description: Research on sexual and reproductive health knowledge, education interventions, and access to care among adolescents including Syrian refugee girls, Latinx youth, and U.S. adolescents, covering topics such as HPV vaccination, privacy laws, and SRH curriculum development.
subtopics.short_description: SRH knowledge, education interventions, and care access among adolescents including refugee and Latinx youth populations.

subtopics.label: Child and Adolescent Mental Health and Social Determinants of Health
subtopics.description: Population-level studies on child and adolescent mental health outcomes in relation to social determinants of health, COVID-19 pandemic impacts, adverse childhood experiences, screen use, and social network influences, including disparities by race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level mental health outcomes in children and adolescents, shaped by adverse experiences, social determinants, and systemic disparities.

subtopics.label: Maternal HIV Antibodies, Vertical Transmission, and Infant Immunization
subtopics.description: Research on maternal HIV-specific antibody responses, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and their role in vertical transmission risk during pregnancy and breastfeeding, including passive immunization strategies and vaccine development for prevention of mother-to-child HIV transmission.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal HIV antibody responses and passive immunization strategies for preventing mother-to-child HIV transmission.

subtopics.label: Congenital Cytomegalovirus Transmission and Maternal Immune Responses
subtopics.description: Studies investigating maternal immune mechanisms—including neutralizing antibodies, Fc-mediated responses, and ADCC-activating antibodies—that influence congenital human cytomegalovirus transmission risk, as well as placental IgG transfer efficiency and vaccine development strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal immune mechanisms influencing congenital cytomegalovirus transmission risk and placental antibody transfer efficiency.

subtopics.label: Pregnancy Complications and Maternal Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research on pregnancy outcomes complicated by maternal medical conditions including autoimmune disorders (lupus, antiphospholipid syndrome), connective tissue disorders (Marfan syndrome), inflammatory bowel disease, sleep apnea, and other chronic conditions affecting gestational health.
subtopics.short_description: Gestational outcomes complicated by autoimmune disorders, connective tissue disease, inflammatory bowel disease, and sleep apnea.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Vascular Complications in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Studies examining cerebrovascular and vascular complications during pregnancy and the postpartum period, including cervical artery dissection, pregnancy-associated stroke, and aortic complications.
subtopics.short_description: Cerebrovascular and vascular complications during pregnancy and postpartum, including pregnancy-associated stroke and aortic events.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis Screening, Prevention, and Immunology in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on tuberculosis diagnosis, prevention, and immune responses during pregnancy, including QuantiFERON assay performance, transcriptional signatures, and safety of preventive therapy regimens in pregnant women.
subtopics.short_description: TB diagnosis, immune responses, and safety of preventive therapy regimens in pregnant women.

subtopics.label: Neonatal Resuscitation, Preterm Infant Care, and NICU Management
subtopics.description: Studies focused on resuscitation techniques, respiratory support, and clinical management of preterm and critically ill neonates in the NICU, including CPAP systems, ventilation strategies, and neonatal hypoglycemia treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Resuscitation techniques, respiratory support, and clinical management of preterm and critically ill neonates.

subtopics.label: Preterm Brain Development and Neurodevelopmental Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining brain development, cerebral blood flow, intraventricular hemorrhage, and neurodevelopmental outcomes in preterm infants, including MRI-based assessments and longitudinal follow-up studies.
subtopics.short_description: Cerebral blood flow, intraventricular hemorrhage, and longitudinal neurodevelopmental outcomes in preterm infants.

subtopics.label: Assisted Reproductive Technology: Outcomes, Access, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies on IVF and ART outcomes including the effects of obesity, underweight status, racial disparities, and clinic membership on live birth rates, as well as stroke risk and cognitive development in ART-conceived children.
subtopics.short_description: IVF and ART live birth rates by obesity, race, and clinic factors, plus long-term health outcomes in ART-conceived children.

subtopics.label: Uterine Fibroids, Myomectomy, and Fertility-Sparing Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of uterine fibroids and other gynecologic conditions through fertility-sparing approaches, including laparoscopic myomectomy, radiofrequency ablation, and reproductive outcomes following surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of uterine fibroids via myomectomy and radiofrequency ablation, with reproductive outcome follow-up.

subtopics.label: Maternal and Perinatal Vaccination: Immunogenicity and Safety
subtopics.description: Studies on vaccine safety and immunogenicity in pregnant and lactating women, including Tdap, HPV, hepatitis B, and COVID-19 vaccines, as well as placental antibody transfer and policy strategies for including pregnant women in vaccine trials.
subtopics.short_description: Vaccine safety and immune responses in pregnant and lactating women, including placental antibody transfer and trial inclusion policy.

subtopics.label: Fetal Programming, Maternal Stress, and Offspring Neurobiology
subtopics.description: Research on how prenatal maternal exposures—including stress, immune activation, hormones, and cytokines—program offspring brain development, anxiety, and behavioral outcomes through biological mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Prenatal stress, immune activation, and hormonal exposures that program offspring brain development and behavioral outcomes.

subtopics.label: Prenatal Diagnosis, Genetic Screening, and Fetal Anomalies
subtopics.description: Studies on prenatal genetic screening, diagnosis of fetal structural and genetic abnormalities, and decision-making around termination of pregnancy for fetal indications, including timing of diagnosis and procedure safety.
subtopics.short_description: Prenatal diagnosis of fetal structural and genetic abnormalities, screening performance, and decision-making around fetal indications.

subtopics.label: Postpartum Depression: Biomarkers, Prediction, and Digital Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on biological predictors of postpartum depression including neuroactive steroids, machine learning risk models, and AI-based educational platforms for screening and supporting affected women.
subtopics.short_description: Neuroactive steroid predictors, machine learning risk models, and AI-based platforms for postpartum depression screening and support.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Infectious Disease Management in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies on the burden, management, and outcomes of infectious diseases in children in resource-limited settings, including sepsis, pneumonia, malaria, tuberculosis, and diarrheal disease in sub-Saharan Africa and other LMICs.
subtopics.display_name: Pediatric Infectious Disease in Low-Resource Settings
subtopics.short_description: Burden and management of sepsis, pneumonia, malaria, and TB in children across sub-Saharan Africa and other LMICs.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Obesity, Nutrition, and Cardiometabolic Risk
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, assessment, and management of obesity and related cardiometabolic conditions in children and adolescents, including dietary patterns, physical activity, and clinical practice guidelines.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and management of childhood obesity and cardiometabolic conditions, including dietary patterns and clinical guidelines.

subtopics.label: Medicaid Expansion, Insurance Coverage, and Child Welfare Policy
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of Medicaid expansion and health insurance policy on child welfare outcomes, foster youth coverage, child maltreatment rates, and access to health services for vulnerable pediatric populations.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of Medicaid expansion and insurance coverage on child maltreatment rates and health access for vulnerable pediatric populations.

subtopics.label: Maternal-Neonatal Microbiome, Immunity, and Breastfeeding
subtopics.description: Research on how maternal gut microbiome, breast milk components, and feeding practices shape neonatal immune development and microbiome composition, including engineered antibody delivery via breast milk.
subtopics.short_description: Breast milk components and feeding practices shaping neonatal immune development and early-life microbiome composition.
